note: The five base styles of REQ-4, expressed as token defaults. A style is data, never a renderer fork: adding one adds an entry here, and the serializer never learns its name. These values are visual product choices and are due an owner review against a rendered page, the way DEC-008 and DEC-013 were — until then they are defaults, not decisions.

styles.name: outline
styles.note: The shape as a line. Nothing is filled, so it reads as a diagram rather than as a mark, and it stays legible on any background.

styles.name: filled
styles.note: A solid mark that keeps a hairline stroke. The stroke is the point: at card size a small island can shrink below one device pixel of fill and disappear, and the stroke keeps it visible.

styles.name: silhouette
styles.note: Fill and nothing else — the flattest possible mark. Distinct from `filled` precisely by having no stroke, which makes it the right choice for a mask or a very small decoration where a stroke would read as noise.

styles.name: bold-soft
styles.note: A soft fill under a confident stroke. The owner's site composition: the shape reads at card size without competing with the text beside it.

styles.name: ghost
styles.note: A watermark. Both fill and stroke drop far enough to sit behind content without being decoration in its own right.
